targetText: Since the capitalist and workman have only to divide this limited value, that is, the value measured by the total labour of the working man, the more the one gets the less will the other get, and vice versa.
explanation: Wages and profits are two shares of the same newly created value. Their relationship is inverse and antagonistic: every rise in the real wage is a fall in the rate of profit, and every fall in wages is a gain for capital. There is no neutral ground.
